pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly polygonal dark regions with diffuse, non-linear edge gradients. Relative spatial area of individual patches is greatest along the upper back and lower neck, transitioning to smaller, more densely clustered geometries toward the hindquarters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Lighter negative-space pathways form a continuous graph with frequent tri-point junction nodes. Pixel thickness of the corridors varies, with wider channels on the upper torso narrowing into a fine-mesh lattice on the rear flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette visible along the upper neck and shoulder line against the background, though detail is softened by motion blur.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced horizontal pixel smearing/motion blur is present across the central and left-central areas of the subject's flank.
